description: This file defines an interface IJwtTokenGenerator for generating JWT tokens, including a method GenerateToken that accepts a User object and returns a token string along with its expiration time.

classes.name: IJwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: An interface that abstracts the functionality for generating JWT tokens.

methods.name: GenerateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for the given User object, returning the token and its expiration timestamp.
